title: The Official Crew Server Modpack
description: A custom modpack made for a group of friends to play together.
body:
Welcome to The Official Crew Server Modpack — the one and only place to get the latest version of the modpack used on our community server!

This modpack is built for The Crew Server and is actively maintained. It will be updated to reflect the latest changes on the server.

If you're looking to join the server, this is the version you’ll need. Be sure to check back often to stay up to date with the latest modpack updates!

Have an idea for a mod or resource pack?

Suggestions are welcome! Crew members can request additions to the modpack or resource packs — just reach out through the usual channels, and your ideas might be included in the next update.
